summary: {senator} tells the people who wrote about hearing-aid prices how to reach the officials writing the rule.
realLife: When the FDA released its proposal, Grassley invited the Iowans who had raised prices with him to comment directly and gave the closing date during his floor remarks.
inGame: needs: constituent correspondence, an open rulemaking docket and its closing date.

turns.what: Staff sends the constituent the docket and deadline.
turns.writesBack: The household can place its experience before the agency.

turns.pulledBy: The constituent calls after the deadline.
turns.what: The office explains that the announced comment period has closed.
turns.writesBack: Staff can still keep the account for legislative oversight.
